title: Botulinum Toxin Injection to Treat Diffuse Esophageal Spasm
brief_summary: This study evaluates the effect of botulinum toxin 100 U or saline, injected endoscopically in the distal esophagus, on symptoms and manometry pattern in patients with diffuse esophageal spasm.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Spastic motor disorder in the upper GI tract
